notes: *any such wickedness as this is* is divided by counting the ASV's determiners against the phrase's morphemes: *any* to the assimilated article of דָּבָר, *this* to the demonstrative pronoun, *such ... as* to the comparative כְּ, with the two agreement articles unrepresented.
*wickedness* is read as one rendering of דָּבָר הָרָע under rule 30's generic-head clause; the alternative gives it to רָע alone and marks דָּבָר unrepresented, which rule 30 forbids.
*no* and *more* are split between לֹא and יוֹסִפוּ under rule 2, each morpheme having a word of its own; reading *no more* as a single fusion was the competing analysis.
